interpretation_rules.deferred: required physical or geographic information is absent or not proven comparable
interpretation_rules.feasible_now: directly observable motion evidence exists; this does not authorize a production layout object
interpretation_rules.feasible_only_as_partial_motion_supporte: motion supports observed portions or transitions but cannot establish completeness
interpretation_rules.feasible_only_with_aggregation: repeated support exists but a persistent estimate requires multiple observations
interpretation_rules.unsupported: the requested complete structure is not identifiable from the frozen evidence

objective: descriptive motion-derived layout-induction feasibility without materializing layout objects

allowed_inputs: procedural tracks derived from canonical motion
semantic motion derived from procedural replay
canonical development maps for the same scenarios

threshold_status: predeclared descriptive engineering criteria, not hypothesis tests
